A series of natural numbers 𝐹1, 𝐹2, 𝐹3, 𝐹4, 𝐹5, 𝐹6, 𝐹7, … obeys 𝐹𝑛+1 = 𝐹𝑛+ 𝐹𝑛−1

The Lucas sequence Ln is deﬁned by the recurrence relation:
Ln = Ln−1 + Ln−2,
for
n ≥3,
with L1 = 1 and L2 = 3.

questions.subtopic: Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions

Substituting initial conditions $L_1 = 1$ and $L_2 = 3$ yields $c_1 = 1$ and $c_2 = 1$.

Suppose two hosts are connected by a point-to-point link and they are conﬁgured
to use Stop-and-Wait protocol for reliable data transfer. Identify in which one of

table. The adversary is malicious who tries to maximize the number of collisions.

system with 32-bit address. The address is sub-divided into TAG, INDEX, and
BLOCK OFFSET.

.

questions.explaination: Address size $= 32\text{ bits}$. Cache size $= 64\text{ KB} = 2^{16}\text{ bytes}$. For an 8-way set-associative cache, the combined capacity of index and offset is $\frac{\text{Cache Size}}{\text{Associativity}} = \frac{64\text{ KB}}{8} = 8\text{ KB} = 2^{13}\text{ bytes}$, requiring $13\text{ bits}$ for INDEX + BLOCK OFFSET. Therefore, the number of TAG bits is $32 - 13 = 19\text{ bits}$.
